notes.title: "LIFE" not found; - Engine Update
notes.content:
[h3]
This update replaces the old game version with the new version of the game made with the Godot Engine. There is no new content, this is just a recreation in the Godot Engine.[/h3]

[b]Although there is no new content [i]yet[/i], I did add some Quality of Life additions. Some of them being:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right Click now closes apps
[*] You can now close apps by clicking on its icon again, when this is possible its icon will be visibly highlighted.
[*] You can scroll in Grammer, Tweeter & Diary using WASD, the arrow keys and the Mouse Scroll Wheel.
[*] Audio Sliders for volume control.
[*] Quick access to the Cursed Diary from the Unlocked Prohibited folder.
[/list]
I will be making another announcement / life update post here on Steam & in my Discord server soon, probably by the end of this week.  

That's all! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: "LIFE" not found; #1 Anniversary Post & DISCOUNT
notes.content:
[b]Hey, it's been a year since "LIFE" not found; was released. Making the game had many ups & downs, so did releasing it. But that's now 1 year ago. I've been surprised at the positive reception the game's been getting ever since the first reviews started rolling in, and I still am surprised to this day. [/b]

It started with positive reviews, then came analysis videos done by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Paracosm]Paracosm[/url] & [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Graeldon]Graeldon[/url] and gameplay videos by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RackedOutGamer]RackedOutGamer[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@kyzka4185]Kyzka[/url] & [url=https://www.youtube.com/@NoctisProditor]NoctisProditor[/url], to name a few. [url=https://www.youtube.com/@fuzzybloodpc9291]Fuzzybloodpc[/url] even did a time-based speedrun, having beaten the game in 28.42 seconds. I could never have expected "LIFE" not found; to do so well, I expected to be made fun of instead lol. The OST (mainly diligence;) has also been performing quite well on streaming services.

Now, one year has passed. I felt like giving a 1 year post-"LIFE" not found; update on how my life has changed, you can read more here: [url=https://www.berch1n.com/games/life-not-found/anniversary]https://www.berch1n.com/games/life-not-found/anniversary[/url] 

[b]I also composed new songs for the anniversary! [/b] You can find them in the link above as well.

[b]To celebrate the anniversary, both the Soundtrack & Behind The Screens are on sale until the end of tomorrow, June 25th![/b]
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908970/LIFE_not_found_Soundtrack/]"LIFE" not found; Soundtrack[/url] is [u][b]90%[/b][/u] off!
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061400/LIFE_not_found_Behind_The_Screens/]"LIFE" not found; Behind The Screens[/url] is [u][b]87%[/b][/u] off! (I couldn't put it any lower it hurts my eyes too)

[b]Thank you for supporting "LIFE" not found;, I hope to see you in the next one. :D[/b]

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Patch
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Background Icon would disappear after Settings Menu was closed, that's now fixed.

[b]Quality of Life Changes[/b]
- The game now doesn't close itself after jumpscares, only after the first jumpscare, because... [i][u][b]L O R E[/b][/u][/i]
- The game doesn't close itself after the "Slightly opened white door" puzzle area.

#1 Anniversary post will come later today, so I'll keep this short. Thank you for your continued support throughout this year!

If you encounter any bugs, glitches or other issues with "LIFE" not found;, please let me know [b]as soon as possible[/b]! You can find me the [url=https://discord.gg/aGSzCQyAzn]Discord Server[/url]. Otherwise, feel free to send a mail to support@berch1n.com.

notes.title: Nominate "LIFE" not found; for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h2]I'd like to thank everyone again for all the support! You're all amazing![/h2]

[b]"LIFE" not found;[/b] has been out for a while now and seems to have resonated with quite a few of you.
I'm forever grateful for all the support and messages received. I hope more people get to play the game in the future. 

OUTSTANDING STORY-RICH GAME AWARD
[quote]"Some days, only a narrative-heavy game will hit the spot, and this one packs a wallop. It's as gripping as any soap opera, and as well-tuned as a prestige-TV screenplay. Bravissimo -- for making us feel things!"[/quote]
[b]If you enjoyed "LIFE" not found; please consider giving it your nomination for the Steam Awards 2022![/b]

Also, if you're interested, the DLC is 30% off during the ongoing Autumn sale. 

Thanks again for all the support!

notes.title: ANNOUNCING GIVEAWAY CHALLENGE
notes.content:
[h3][b]"LIFE" not found; has had quite good user reviews so far! It even got a Positive score! To celebrate, I thought I'd hold a little giveaway challenge![/b][/h3]

If [b]"LIFE" not found;[/b] gets an additional 500 [b]first-time[/b] downloads by [b]July 5th 00:00 (12AM) GMT+2[/b], I'll give away [b]20 keys[/b] of [b]BOTH[/b] the Soundtrack and the Behind The Scenes DLC.

However, that's not all! If [b]"LIFE" not found;[/b] manages to get an additional 500 [b]first-time[/b] downloads on top of that [b](1000 total)[/b], I'll give away [b]50 keys[/b] of both the Soundtrack and the Behind The Scenes DLC, instead of [b]20[/b]!

To those who haven't tried the game out yet, or still have it on their wishlist, this is your prime opportunity to try it out! Most playthroughs so far have lasted only about 1 hour, you won't regret it. :)

[i]For those who have already played the game (or haven't), please make sure to share the game around with friends and/or family, every new player helps all of us out a ton![/i] 

Before I released the game, I had doubts about the game, similar ones to the game that's mentioned inside [b]"LIFE" not found;[/b]. I was worried the game might not have enough content or that it's too short to be enjoyable, but reading all the positive feedback has reassured me a lot! So, I just wanted to say

[b][h3]Thank You.[/h3][/b]
To those who've already played the game, to those who left a review regardless of it being positive or negative and to those who do so in the future. [i](I give rewards to my favorites when I have points to spare)[/i]

For the time being, I'm going to take it easy. If you'd like to stay up to date with my future projects, make sure to follow me on my socials below. [b]I hope to see you again with my next game release![/b]
